record.reason: The publisher full text describes PoseRWGCN: RWKV temporal stream plus GCN spatial stream for 3D human-pose sequences, with causal and bidirectional modes; on two pose datasets it reports 62.1% fewer FLOPs than its baseline. The evaluation is task-specific pose estimation and supplies no language-model result or transferable LLM serving test.
record.title: PoseRWGCN: an attention-free dual-stream RWKV-GCN architecture for real-time 3D human pose estimation
